name: No Business Like Show Business
source: Today, you have the biggest audition of your life! Will you land a role in Aaron Santos' hot new Broadway musical? It's time for you to sing, dance, and act your way to stardom!
translation: 今天，你将迎来人生中最重要的一次试镜！你能在亚伦·桑托斯备受瞩目的百老汇新音乐剧中获得一个角色吗？是时候凭借歌声、舞步与演技，走上成名之路了！
